summary: Routes that create a scenario under a model and read one scenario back.
purpose: A scenario is one version of a model with its own assumptions, such as a base case or a downside case.
why: Likely reason: lets one model be tested under different assumptions.
how: Create saves a new scenario with a model id, name, optional description and default flag, then returns it. Get returns one scenario by id or a not-found error.
inputs: On create: model id, name, optional description, and the default flag. On read: the scenario id in the web address.
outputs: The saved scenario record, or a not-found error.
risks: The model id is not checked to exist before saving, so an unknown id depends on database rules. Setting one scenario as default does not clear the flag on others.
debug: If create fails with a database error, confirm the model id exists. If two scenarios show as default, the flag was not cleared on the other one.
